title: A Supervisor with the sequential strategy runs its team hub and spoke: the supervisor frames the first worker's task in a child room, each worker hands its work back through submit_result, the supervisor judges each step through submit_verdict in a child room and frames the next task, the next worker is handed the validated work, and the delegate_workers call answers with a digest of the reviewed steps
notes: Python: tests/test_supervisor.py TestStrategyToolHandler::test_sequential_strategy_tool, TestSupervisedSequential::test_validates_and_frames_each_step, test_dispatch_and_review_leave_the_strategy_tool_in_its_room, test_worker_structured_payload_is_rendered_for_review, TestReviewUsesTheVerdictTool::test_the_review_forces_submit_verdict. orchestration/strategies/supervisor/supervised.py (_dispatch_prompt, _review_brief, _run_supervised_sequential, _step_ended), prompts.py (SUBMIT_VERDICT, _compose_supervised_handoff, _format_supervised_digest), results.py _render_result, _worker_profile. A turn goes on after its submit_result or submit_verdict call (its result reads received), so each such turn ends on a round of its own. The child rooms never declare delegate_workers; the step's terminal status entry is its rendered result (strategy supervised).

submit_verdict.description: Submit your verdict on this step of the team's work. You MUST call this exactly once; it is the ONLY way your judgement reaches the team.

approved.description: true only if the output genuinely fulfills the step.

feedback.description: What to fix, precisely, when not approved; else empty.

next_task.description: When approved and a next worker exists, its self-contained task; else empty.

delegate_workers.description: Delegate a task to ALL workers (Analyst, critic) at once. Call this tool exactly ONCE with the topic. All workers run automatically in sequential mode. Do NOT split into separate calls per worker.

task.description: The topic or task — sent to all workers as-is
